scope: local canonical only; no CentOS, broker, restart, deployment, or Git push action

change.reason: Allow exact existing bot25 state-v5/man231 or state-v6/V23 positions to continue under V24 without creating replacement seed orders.
migration_guards: exact state and broker position identifier set
exact side, lot, magic, comment, and symbol ownership
zero pending open, close, post-close, productive-close, and close-defer lifecycle
single expected legacy strategy key only
no duplicate state or broker position identifier
logical side cap and 3:1 ratio remain valid
change.transitional_core: One best-price existing physical position per side substitutes for that side's virtual core until the existing exit path closes it.
change.shadow_canary: Exact read-only state/broker verification and status only while migrated real positions exist; no reconciliation, add, close, or simulated lifecycle mutation.

compose_scope.reason: The local canonical Compose contains unrelated user changes; only the two bot25 lines are selected for Git.
selected_changes: bot25 service comment identifies V24 shadow-only canary
BOT25_ENABLE_REAL_TRADING defaults empty instead of embedding the retired MAN231 acknowledgement

covers: new episode and restart create zero seed orders
frontier add creates exactly one broker order
exact nonflat state-v5 inventory migrates without double core
a broker-confirmed close of a migrated physical core uses the existing sync path and activates only that side's virtual core
pending lifecycle, lot mismatch, pending order, duplicate ID, malformed value, and extra strategy key preserve the old state and fail closed
shadow-only canary with matching or mismatching real inventory leaves the canonical position lifecycle unchanged
a transitional physical-core mapping suppresses a virtual core only on the same side
